name: UA-SK-Gate
title: Gate Access Starter Kit
summary: Gate Starter Kit: Gate Hub + 7" camera Intercom + PoE++ adapter + 2-wire PoE extenders for vehicle gates.

special: LPR unlock with Protect AI camera
requires: Protect AI camera for license-plate unlock

extra.kit: Gate Hub, Intercom, U-PoE++ adapter, 2x UACC-Extender-2Wire
extra.poe_out_note: spec says PoE outputs 30W/port max 55W aggregated

gotchas: License Plate Unlock requires a separate compatible Protect AI camera and Protect console.
Gate Hub is indoor-only unless mounted in a waterproof junction box.
2-wire extenders are 10/100 HomePlug — fine for the intercom, not high-bandwidth.
Needs UniFi Access on a console; doesn't include the gate operator.
best_for: driveway/vehicle gates with intercom + side door
